title: THE PRICE OF MONEY
voice: The ten year yield reads 5.244 percent and the thirty year 5.600 percent in the market feed. The official Treasury series puts the twenty year yield at 5.64 percent, dated 2026-10-08. Yield changes and bond price changes are different things: rising yields generally mean falling bond prices. Higher long term yields can pressure equity valuations and financing costs.

title: TWO PATHS. ONE CHECKLIST.
voice: For the constructive scenario, look for the major indexes to hold their support references, breadth to improve, and volatility to remain contained. For the risk scenario, watch support breaks accompanied by weaker participation or rising yields and volatility. Surprise inflation, earnings guidance and geopolitical developments can change the picture quickly. None of these conditions guarantees a move.
